_comment: agent SkillSet 1.0 (design v0.5.1 §4): one script for every event. Inert unless the session is bound to a run,
except the guard-seen marker (PreToolUse, SessionStart), the session id for KairosChain's own agent tools, and the
operator's words that may adopt, confirm or correct something (UserPromptSubmit). PreToolUse fails closed only in a
bound session: there a guard that cannot decide refuses (onFailure block), and if the script or ruby is missing or
ruby fails (an rbenv version not installed) while this session's binding file exists the tool call is blocked
(exit 2); any other session goes on (exit 0). Other events exit 0 when the script is absent, so a removed SkillSet
never blocks ordinary sessions. Timeouts (3900 s) sit above two stand-in calls (llm_client timeout 600 s each,

hooks.command:
d="${KAIROS_DATA_DIR:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.kairos}"; f="$d/skillsets/agent/hooks/agent_hook.rb"; i=$(cat); if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v ruby >/dev/null 2>&1; then o=$(printf '%s
' "$i" | ruby "$f") && { [ -z "$o" ] || printf '%s
' "$o"; exit 0; }; fi; s=$(printf '%s
' "$i" | sed -n 's/"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\)".*/"\1/p' | sed 's/.*"//' | head -n 1); if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -f "$d/storage/agent/bindings/$s" ]; then echo "agent guard unavailable in a session bound to a run ($d)" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
